thatmakessense.config.title: That Makes Sense
thatmakessense.config.noCropTrample.enab: When on, farmland never reverts to dirt when players, mobs, or projectiles land on it. Fall damage still applies.
thatmakessense.config.silkTouchBudding.e: When on, mining a budding amethyst block with a Silk Touch tool drops the block, making amethyst geodes renewable.
thatmakessense.config.enchantments.infin: Allow a bow to carry both Infinity and Mending.
thatmakessense.config.enchantments.stack: Allow the melee damage enchantments (Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Impaling, Density, Breach) to coexist on one weapon.
thatmakessense.config.blackstoneRecipe.e: When on, a blast furnace smelts cobblestone into blackstone (a regular furnace still makes stone). On a server this is decided by the server.
thatmakessense.config.doubleDoors.enable: Opening one door of a matching pair opens both, like a real double door. Iron doors are left to redstone.
thatmakessense.config.noBerryDamage.enab: Sweet berry bushes no longer hurt you when you walk through them (mobs still take the damage).
Right-clicking a fully-grown crop (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart) harvests it and replants it in place. Sneak to place blocks instead.
thatmakessense.config.noCreeperBlockDama: Creeper explosions still hurt you and drop mobs, but no longer destroy terrain.
thatmakessense.config.noEndermanGriefing: Disables the enderman AI that picks up and places blocks, so they stop rearranging your builds.
thatmakessense.config.totemFromInventory: A Totem of Undying saves you from anywhere in your inventory, not just when held in a hand.
thatmakessense.config.disablePhantoms.en: Phantoms never spawn from not sleeping. (Spawn eggs and commands still work.)
thatmakessense.config.noPetTeleportDamag: Tamed pets take no fall damage when they teleport to you.
thatmakessense.config.noEnderPearlDamage: Throwing an ender pearl no longer deals the teleport (fall) damage on arrival.
thatmakessense.config.rottenFleshLeather: Smelting rotten flesh in a furnace yields leather.
thatmakessense.config.zombieJerky.enable: Smoke Rotten Flesh into Zombie Jerky
Cooking rotten flesh in a smoker yields Zombie Jerky, a small always-edible snack.
thatmakessense.config.stackableTotems.en: Totems of Undying stack up to 64 instead of one at a time. Resolved server-side, so a server's setting wins.
Adds a button to your inventory that hides your own armor from view while keeping it equipped. Only changes what you see, not what others see.
thatmakessense.config.noGhastFireballDam: Ghast fireball explosions still hurt entities but no longer destroy terrain.
thatmakessense.config.cobwebShears.enabl: Cobweb breaks instantly when mined with shears (and still drops cobweb).
thatmakessense.config.villagerStock.enab: Villagers sell each trade several times as often before it locks (4x by default; still restock). Change the multiplier in the config file. Server-authoritative.
thatmakessense.config.bonemealExtras.ena: Bonemeal Nether Wart, Cactus & Sugar Cane
Bonemeal grows nether wart, and adds a segment to cactus and sugar cane (up to their natural height).
thatmakessense.config.stableVillagerPric: Villager trade prices stop climbing when a trade is used heavily. Discounts (Hero of the Village, curing a zombie villager) still apply.
thatmakessense.config.longerLeads.enable: Leashed mobs can wander about 24 blocks before the lead breaks (vanilla is 12). Change the distance in the config file.
Infinity Works on Tipped & Spectral Arrows
An Infinity bow shoots any arrow for free, not just plain arrows. Fired arrows can't be picked up, so there's no duplication.
thatmakessense.config.healParrots.enable: Feed Seeds to Heal Tamed Parrots
Feeding seeds to an injured tamed parrot heals it, like feeding wolves or cats (parrots otherwise have no way to heal).
thatmakessense.config.petProtection.enab: Pets Immune to You & Your Pets
Your tamed pets take no damage from you or your other tamed pets, so sweeping attacks, stray arrows, and infighting can't hurt them. Other players, mobs, and the environment still do.
thatmakessense.config.noPetFallDamage.en: Tamed Pets Take No Fall Damage
Tamed wolves, cats, and parrots take no fall damage (they path badly off ledges). Other damage still applies.
